title: Generative vs. Encoder Models for Multilingual NER: A Comprehensive Empirical Study on Naamapadam
abstract: arXiv:2608.29959v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language is humanity's most consequential technology, yet for over a billion speakers across India's twenty-two constitutionally recognised languages, its digital layer remains structurally incomplete. Named Entity Recognition (NER), the foundational step in transforming raw text into machine-interpretable knowledge, has been studied exhaustively for English but remains largely unsolved across most Indic languages. This paper presents a rigorous comparative study of generative and encoder-based neural architectures for NER on all eleven languages of the Naamapadam benchmark. We evaluate five classic model families spanning sequence-to-sequence transformers and multilingual encoders; four decoder-only large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned with LoRA and 4-bit NF4 quantisation; and nine generative models in zero-to-5-shot inference. translated_title: 生成式模型与编码器模型在多语言命名实体识别中的对比：基于Naamapadam基准的全面实证研究
translated_abstract: 语言是人类最重要的技术，然而对于印度22种宪法承认语言的超过十亿使用者而言，其数字层在结构上仍不完整。命名实体识别（NER）是将原始文本转化为机器可解释知识的基础步骤，尽管针对英语的研究已十分充分，但在大多数印度语言中仍未得到解决。本文对生成式与基于编码器的神经架构在Naamapadam基准全部11种语言上的NER任务进行了严格的比较研究。我们评估了五个经典模型家族（涵盖序列到序列Transformer与多语言编码器）；四个经LoRA与4位NF4量化微调的仅解码器大语言模型（LLM）；以及九个在零样本至5样本推理设置下的生成式模型。在严格的CoNLL span级评估下，基于编码器的模型（mBERT与XLM-R，在印地语上F1均为0.675）超……
tldr: 本文在Naamapadam基准的全部11种印度语言上，系统性地比较了生成式架构（含LoRA微调LLM与少样本生成模型）与编码器架构在命名实体识别任务上的表现，发现编码器模型（mBERT/XLM-R）整体表现超越生成式方法。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a comprehensive empirical comparison of generative and encoder-based architectures for NER across all eleven languages of the Naamapadam benchmark, showing that encoder models (mBERT/XLM-R) surpass LoRA-fine-tuned and few-shot generative LLMs under strict CoNLL span-level evaluation.
